macros.name: AfterTheoremHeaderChar
macros.doc: The \AfterTheoremHeaderChar{⟨after-char⟩} command specifies an hafter-char i element that ends header of theorem and header of proof.

macros.name: AfterTheoremHeaderSkip
macros.doc: The \AfterTheoremHeaderSkip{⟨skip-command⟩} command specifies a command inserted between theorem header and body.

macros.name: apar
macros.doc: The \apar[⟨title⟩] command starts a new apar-numbered paragraph.

macros.name: apar
macros.doc: The \apar[⟨title⟩] command starts a new apar-numbered paragraph.

macros.name: newtheoremtype
macros.doc: The \newtheoremtype command allows create new theorem types.

macros.name: proof
macros.doc: The \proof command prints the proof of a math statement.

macros.name: proof
macros.doc: The \proof command prints the proof of a math statement.

macros.name: ProofStyleParameters
macros.doc: The \ProofStyleParameters{⟨style⟩}{⟨title⟩} command specifies style parameters used in the \proof command: the first one is a font style and the last one is a proof title.

macros.name: qed
macros.doc: The \qed command is used to finish a proof. It prints right-adjusted Q.E.D. symbol and applies the \qef command (it finishes this paragraph).

macros.name: qed*
macros.doc: The \qed command is used to finish a proof. It prints right-adjusted Q.E.D. symbol and applies the \qef command (it finishes this paragraph).

macros.name: qef
macros.doc: The \qef command finishes a paragraph, changes the current font to the normal font, and skips a \paragraph-like vertical space.

macros.name: renewtheorem
macros.doc: Every theorem environment and theorem type can be redefined with \renewtheorem and \renewtheoremtype.

macros.name: renewtheoremtype
macros.doc: Every theorem environment and theorem type can be redefined with \renewtheorem and \renewtheoremtype.

macros.name: TheoremCommentDelimiters
macros.doc: The \TheoremCommentDelimiters{⟨left⟩}{⟨right⟩} command specifies delimiters inserted before and after a theorem comment.
